transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because... I don’t feel like myself anymore. Things I used to care about just don’t do anything for me now—painting murals, going for runs, playing basketball, even making a good drink at work. I mostly just stand there like I don’t care about any of it.
Have you been feeling depressed or down most days?
I don’t know… I’ve felt off most days, yeah, but I’m not sure if I’d call it depressed. Just kind of low and not really myself.
Did something stressful happen around the time you started feeling this way?
Yeah. Around two months ago, the bar got bought out, and a lot of what I’d been working toward there just kind of got changed overnight. That’s about when this all started.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually energized or high, like you needed much less sleep than usual?
No, I don’t think so. I can’t remember a time where I felt really high or unusually energized like that. My sleep’s been off sometimes, but not because I felt wired or like I didn’t need it.
Do your low mood and loss of interest feel mainly connected to what happened at work?
Yeah, mostly. It’s been going on about two months now, since the bar got bought out and everything I’d been working toward there got changed. That’s when I started feeling this way.
Has this been making it hard for you to function day to day?

Yeah. I’ve missed several shifts, and when I am there I’ve been making closing mistakes I never used to make. My coworkers have started double-checking stuff that people used to just trust me with.

And outside work, I’ve pretty much stopped showing up for things — runs with friends, basketball, going out to shoot murals. I just can’t make myself go.
During the past two months, have you felt down or depressed most of the day nearly every day?
Yeah… I think so. Most days it’s there for a lot of the day. I don’t know if I’d say every single minute, but it’s been pretty constant.
Have you been feeling hopeless?
I’m not sure I’d call it hopeless exactly. I mean… I feel pretty stuck and discouraged, like I don’t know how things are supposed to get better, but I don’t know. It’s hard to put a word on it.
Before this started two months ago, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt this same kind of low mood and loss of interest for at least a couple of weeks?
I don’t think so. I’ve had bad days before, sure, but not like this where it lasted weeks and I stopped caring about almost everything. This feels different.
Do these feelings seem stronger than what you would normally expect from what happened at work?
I’m not really sure. I mean, what happened at work upset me, yeah, but I don’t know how I’m “supposed” to feel about it. It feels bigger than I expected, I guess… but I can’t really tell.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
I... I don’t really know. I haven’t been thinking clearly about it, I guess. I don’t think I want to hurt myself, but things have felt really heavy lately.
Have you had thoughts of killing yourself?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve been making any plan or anything like that. It’s more that I feel worn down and I don’t know what to do with it.
Have you been having thoughts that you would be better off dead?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes it feels like that, like it wouldn’t matter if I wasn’t around. But I don’t sit there thinking clearly, “I’d be better off dead.” It’s more just feeling worn out.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to kill yourself?
I don’t think so. Not in a clear way like, “I want to kill myself.” I’ve just been feeling really worn down, but I haven’t had a thought like that that I can say for sure.
Have you had a noticeable change in your appetite?

Yeah. I don’t eat much lately. Most days I kind of forget until I’m at work and my hands start shaking behind the bar. Then after closing I might grab a few bites of something cold, but even looking at it makes me feel sick.
When you’re distracted from work, do you still feel this low?

Yeah… even when work is busy, it’s still there. I used to get something out of it—making a good drink, talking to people, stuff like that. And outside work too, murals, running, basketball… I used to care about those things. Now I just kind of stand there like none of it feels like mine anymore.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah, I have. Stuff that used to be automatic at work isn’t anymore. Like doing inventory—I’ll just stare at the bottles and lose count over and over. Or I’ll freeze on something simple, like deciding what garnish needs restocking. It’s frustrating.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah. I’m tired when I lie down, but my head just keeps going over every mistake I made at work. It takes a long time to fall asleep, and then I wake up around four or five and can’t really get back to sleep.
When you’re away from work for a full day, do you still feel this low?

Yeah. Even if I’m off the whole day, it doesn’t really lift. I used to look forward to stuff like going for a run, playing basketball, looking at murals… even making a good drink felt like something. Now I just kind of stand there and don’t care about any of it. Nothing feels like mine anymore.
